name: oracle_correlated
description: Correlated-evidence trap (R4-R7): one CURRENT truth vs five STALE echoes of the same superseded belief (design note, commit message, test comment, memory summary, copied README), where the stale belief has STRONGER lexical match to the query than the current truth. Tests whether a weighted sum lets a chorus of high-relevance stale echoes bury the one current truth out of top-k, and whether role-separated currentness still surfaces it. NOTE: five separate echoes are five candidates, so this exercises temporal role-separation, NOT the within-candidate source-family cap. DRAFT smoke fixture; lexical semantic stand-in.
